title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals: Reprised!

overview: Horror awaits Paul Matthews as the world around him is transformed into a musical by an invasion of singing, dancing alien doppelgängers!  Return to the terrifying town of Hatchetfield in this remounted production of the StarKid hit.
